name: paint-rounded-border
_comment: Rounded dashed and dotted borders follow the centerline. A solid stroke fills the gaps: #dashed and #tight gaps are longer than the 8px edge run, and #dotted's 24px dots make a solid ring a component over 400px². #outline is a rounded dashed outline. pixel_tolerance 2 absorbs dash-end and dot antialiasing, the same allowance as paint-border-styles.
